Hi Maya —

Quick one: OpenServing (Sept 22-24) is putting together a small panel + short customer spotlights on production LLM serving. We'd love to feature Hafner Analytics as a customer session titled “Serving at Scale: Hafner’s pragmatic approach.”

Ask: 20-minute customer session + sit on the 40-minute panel that follows. Audience is platform engineers and ML infra leads (60–120 attendees). Logistics we can cover: travel stipend, registration, and a small honorarium if needed.

Would you be open to this? If yes, we can:
- lock a speaker slot (requires confirmation by July 21)
- schedule a 30-minute pre-brief with our product + events team to align on talking points and slides

High level topics we think resonate: deployment/hot-swap rollouts, prefix caching strategies, and the economics/observability tradeoffs you run into in production. If there’s something else you’d prefer to highlight, we’ll adapt.

Links: OpenServing event page (for context) — https://openservingconf.org/2026. HubSpot record for the invite: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/HAFNER-789

If you can confirm today/this week, I’ll follow up with the pre-brief times. Thanks again for being such a great partner.

Best,
